marketing_description: The Speed Queen® DC5004BG sanitizing gas dryer delivers a 7 cu‑ft capacity and 22000 Btu/hr BTU rating, powered by gas and featuring a galvanized steel drum. It offers 11 cycles, 5 temperature settings, and advanced features such as anti‑static, commercial cool‑down technology, extended tumble, lint filter guard, moisture sensor, pet plus, and multiple steam options, all within a 43‑in height, 26‑7/8‑in width, 28‑in depth black enclosure. The unit operates at 120 V with 220 cfm exhaust airflow through a 4‑in diameter outlet and a 3/8‑in gas inlet, and includes a status section for cycle progression awareness.
